title: Pakistan cement sales rise by 0.4% year-on-year in October 2026
summary: Pakistan cement sales rise by 0.4% year-on-year in October 2026
body_markdown:
**Pakistan:** According to the All Pakistan Cement Manufacturers Association, cement sales in Pakistan increased by 0.4% year-on-year to 4.81Mt in October 2026. Cement exports, on the other hand, fell by 3.7% year-on-year to 770,000t, mainly due to the closure of the border with Afghanistan.


In the first four months of the 2027 financial year (July-October), total cement sales rose by 2.9% year-on-year to 18Mt. Exports fell by 9.5% year-on-year to 3.1Mt.
